sloka: अहमाकाशमापन्ना ह्युपर्युपरि सागरम् ।प्रपतेयं हि ते पृष्ठाद्भयाद् वेगेन गच्छतः ।। ५.३७.४४।।।।
transliteration: ahamākāśamāpannā hyuparyupari sāgaram ।prapateyaṁ hi te pṛṣṭhādbhayād vegena gacchataḥ ।। 5.37.44।।।।

translations.english: "O sinless and foremost monkey going with you is not proper for me. Your windlike speed will render me unconscious.
